raw_segments.text: Lear, the king would speak with Cornwall, the dear father would with his daughter speak,
commands, tens, service, are they informed of this?
The fiery duke, tell the hot duke that no but not yet, maybe he is not well, infirmity
doth still neglect all office where to our health is bound, we are not ourselves when
nature, being oppressed, commands the mind to suffer with the body, I'll forbear, and
am fallen out with my more headier will, to take the indisposed and sickly fit for the
down man, looking on Kent, death on my state, wherefore should he sit here, this act persuades
me that this remotion of the duke and her is practice only, give me my servant forth,
go tell the duke and his wife I'd speak with them, now presently, bid them come forth and
hear me, or at their chamber door I'll beat the drum till it cries sleep to death.
